lines:
DAY 9. 180 FEET UP. THE
SAFEST BUILDING ON EARTH.

IT'S RUN WITHOUT A CREW
FOR FORTY DAYS.

ONE HELIDECK. ONE LADDER.
THEY CAN'T SWIM OR CLIMB.

YOU WINCH IT UP.
NOW THERE IS NO WAY UP.

RADIO: HOLD AT RIG BRAVO.
OWN WATER. OWN POWER.

YOU KILL THE LIGHTS.
THE RIG IS GONE.

60 BUNKS. A YEAR OF FOOD.
ZERO WAYS UP.

RULE 3. READ THE LOG BEFORE
YOU TOUCH ANYTHING.

6:20 PM. 39 DAYS OF ENTRIES.
EVERY ONE ROUTINE.

40 PEOPLE. ZERO WAYS UP.
AND IT CAME BY RADIO.
